mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 AM, here is today's balanced dish: expect overcast skies with a temperature of 64 degrees around Badger Ridge Middle School.

The Verona Finance Department has published the proposed 2027 annual budget. You can review the full budget documents and 2025 financial statements on the city website or visit City Hall on Lincoln Street during their business hours.

We have a busy schedule! Today features live music at both Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, check out yoga at Insight Wellness, and mark your calendars for trivia starting this Monday at Hop Haus and Lake Lou-ee.

On Wednesday, October 15, the Verona Police Department arrested a school bus driver for O W I. Fortunately, no injuries were reported, and the department is currently investigating a collision with a traffic sign.
Today's flavor is the delicious Snickers Swirl. The store is currently open and will remain open until 10:00 PM tonight, so stop by and enjoy a scoop.
